Name: opening_range_hold_time_one_variable
Title: Opening Range Breakout Hold-Time Sensitivity With Costed OOS Split
Experiment: Change only hold_bars while keeping data source, opening range, costs, and entry rule fixed. Reject if the improvement appears only in train, if OOS trade count is too small, or if post-cost OOS profit factor is below the promotion threshold.

Name: opening_range_width_filter_one_variable
Title: Opening Range Width Filter as a Risk Control
Experiment: Add one opening-range-width filter and compare against the baseline. Do not change entry, exit, data source, or costs in the same run. Reject if the filter merely removes most trades or fails OOS after costs.

Name: prediction_probability_shift_overlay
Title: Prediction-Market Probability Shift as a Futures Context Overlay
Experiment: Use prediction-market event probability shifts only as a binary context overlay on existing futures trades. Do not create futures entries from prediction data alone. Reject unless OOS expectancy improves after costs without shrinking sample below the contract.
